_doc: The deliveryman's event Pokémon after his other gifts (the user, 2026-11-09: "Mew, Celebi, Jirachi and Deoxys come from the
deliveryman after the Champion, as copies of real Gen 4-era events"; notes/POSTGAME_DEX.md). patches/event_gifts.py makes each
a Black 2 Mystery Gift card (the fateful mark and met data come from Black 2's own maker, CreateMysteryGiftPokemon) for the
decomp's extension 0xA9; src/include/pearl_story.inc pl_DeliveryGive gives them in this order (pl_DeliveryEventSpecies names
them in the same order). Nature, IVs and personality at random, as the events'; the Met game is the build's (version.MET_GAME);
the met date is the day it is received. Moves and items by the decomp's names; place: Black 2's event place (system text
bank 110: 40001 + its line, 40001 'Lovely place', 40059 'Pokémon Event'). Source: Serebii's event pages
(serebii.net/events/dex/151, 251, 385, 386.shtml), read 2026-11-09; the Ranch Mew's ball and met place also from Project
Pokémon's event file (as a search quoted it). The four are English (USA) distributions for the Gen 4 games.
